TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian travellers aged 22-32, app-first, planning their first big Ladakh trip, usually going with two or three friends rather than alone
KNOWN_PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES: Browse curated places based on stated preferences
Search and book flights: one-way or round-trip, with from, to, depart date, travellers and cabin
Create a trip that holds multiple destinations and a count of activities
Plan a trip together with other travellers on one shared trip
Create Memories from photos already on the phone (app only)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: An itinerary is not one decision, it is thirty small ones. Right now those thirty decisions live in a group chat, six blogs, a notes app and someone's screenshots, and nobody can see the whole plan at once.
